notes.text:
This update for guava, j2objc-annotations fixes the following issue:

- CVE-2026-102554: Allocation of resources without limits or throttling (CWE-770) during Java object deserialization
  allows an attacker to cause a Denial of Service via OutOfMemoryError (bsc#1284985).

Changes for guava:

- Upgrade to version 33.7.2

Changes for j2objc-annotations:

- Update to version 3.0.0

notes.text: Allocation of resources without limits or throttling (CWE-770) during Java object deserialization in Google Guava versions 4.0 through 33.7.1 allows an attacker to cause a Denial of Service via OutOfMemoryError. When deserializing CompactHashMap, CompactHashSet, or MapMakerInternalMap instances, Guava eagerly allocates an array based on a caller-specified size parameter without throttling, permitting memory exhaustion from crafted serialization streams.
